title: Spot the difference: beach
prompt: Three things changed between the two beach pictures. Which list names all three changes?
explanation: Compare the two pictures bit by bit: The green book changed colour from red to green, the gray cloud changed colour from white to gray and the green turtle vanished. Nothing else is different.
reviewNote: Independent review passed: answer re-derived from scene data, difficulty and safety checked. Published under the owner's 18 Nov 2026 direction.
